colorScheme.description: Specifies a Color Brewer color scheme to use on the series (http://colorbrewer2.org/).

colors.description: If provided, the colors listed here will override the colors used in the colorScheme.

normal.description: The style applied to the default state of the trend.

highlighted.description: The style applied to the highlighted state of the trend.

selected.description: The style applied to the selected state of the trend.

muted.description: The style applied to the muted (unselected) state of the trend.

color.description: The color to apply to the line stroke, if applicable.

width.description: The width to apply to the line stroke, if applicable.

opacity.description: The opacity to apply to the line stroke, if applicable.

dashArray.description: The spacing to apply between dashes of the line stroke, if applicable.

color.description: The color to apply to the trend fill, if applicable.

opacity.description: The opacity to apply to the trend fill, if applicable.
